title: How do I stop a recurring payment?
summary: Explains how to stop a recurring payment by opening the scheduled payment, selecting Cancel, and confirming to prevent future occurrences. Notes that editing is locked within 13 hours and cancellations made close to processing may not stop an imminent occurrence; instructs users to verify the schedule status and whether the next run processed.
